title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics SLO/telemetry integration and runbook linking enhancements
author: Marta Chen
description:
Context: On-call engineers frequently need correlated SLO, trace, and alert telemetry alongside runbooks during incidents. The incident-bot currently links runbooks and basic SLO summaries, but manual jumps to dashboards and traces slows MTTI/MTTR. This PR integrates SLO and telemetry context into incident-bot diagnostics messages, improves runbook linking heuristics, and adds on-call helper actions (timeline snippets, suggested next steps, and quick runbook feedback).

What this PR does: Adds a new telemetry enrichment layer that queries the SLO service and traces/metric explorer via our internal telemetry API and attaches a concise diagnostics summary to on-call posts. Improves runbook linking by adding fuzzy-title matching and last-edit heuristics to prefer runbooks with recent verification tags. Adds a small set of on-call helper actions surfaced in Slack messages: "Capture timeline snapshot", "Run basic health checks", and "Open suggested runbook". Introduces a feature flag (incident_bot.telemetry_enrichment) and a staged rollout plan.

Files/areas touched (high level): incident-bot service (handlers, diagnostics enrichment), telemetry client library (client wrapper and cache TTLs), runbook resolver, Slack message templates, e2e playbook tests, unit tests, and docs (runbook authoring guidance and ops rollout notes).

Why: Reduce cognitive overhead for responders, provide immediate SLO/trace context to triage, and make runbook discovery more reliable. We measured a ~15% improvement in time-to-first-action in internal playbacks when enrichment was enabled (synthetic).

Testing: Unit tests for telemetry client and runbook resolver (new test files added), integration tests that mock telemetry API, and an e2e slack-playback test against a staging workspace. CI flakiness observed in one flaky slack-test; retried and passing. Rollout: Feature-flagged, start with canary for ops-oncall team for 48h, then expand to all oncall channels.

Migration notes: No data migrations. Admins can opt-out by toggling incident_bot.telemetry_enrichment false. Recommended to update runbook metadata with verification tags for improved linking.

Related: Linear ENG-4372, ENG-4410.

Checklist:
- [x] telemetry client wrapper + cache
- [x] incident-bot enrichment pipeline
- [x] runbook linking heuristics
- [x] Slack templates + action buttons
- [x] unit & integration tests
- [x] docs and rollout notes
